query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.createdAt, ou.organizationId, ou.role as orgRole
FROM users u
JOIN organization_users ou ON u.id = ou.userId
WHERE LOWER(u.email) LIKE '%debbie%' OR LOWER(u.email) LIKE '%gregory%' OR LOWER(u.name) LIKE '%debbie%' OR LOWER(u.name) LIKE '%gregory%'
LIMIT 10;
